questions.answer: Reputation as one of the best economics faculties

questions.answer: I received quite a bit of assistance at the beginning through admin staff at the university and especially through the scan design fellowship program

How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was relatively tricky. I started quite late and had trouble finding anything. One should really try and find housing as early as possible.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Living off campus is not a big issue given that Madison is not a particularly large city.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Given that I was only taking graduate level course work, I had to get permission from each professor to partake in their classes. I had to show that I had the required knowledge to successfully complete the classes.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Professors were very responsive when one wrote them.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was able to get into every class I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Write the professors early enough. Classes can fill up and if you get permission after too many students have registered it is too late.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I was taking a mix of master and PhD level courses while there. In comparison to the courses at UCPH, it was extremely challenging and time intensive.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was a very research oriented teaching style with small class sizes

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Econ 700: Mathematics for Economists
Econ 741: Theory of public finance and fiscal policy
Econ 761: Industrial organization theory

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Econ 741 and 761 were great !

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer:
Groceries are surprisingly expensive, especially at the grocery stores in the city. In case one has access to a car it is worth going to one of the larger chains outside of the main city. 

Going out for drinks on state street is really cheep.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
At the beginning of the semester there is a student organisation fair where organisation present themselves and recruit new participants.

I joined the triathlon and hunting club

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Go to a Badgers american football and women's volleyball games.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: If one has the time would recommend visting the cities around Madison (Chicago, Minneapolis, Milwaukee, New Glarus). Madison is relatively small and somewhat limited in its cultural activities.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Quite easy. There was no massive culture shock or adjustment period.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nothing was particularly challenging.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: People are quite open and willing to interact and spend time with you.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Define your priorities and choose your courses accordingly. Some courses are extremely challenging and time intensive while others are an easy A without any work load.

Go to the student organisation fair and join clubs that you are interested in. It is the easiest way to meet people.

Bring a warm winter jacket. Madison gets extremely cold in the winter.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Madison is a small college town, meaning that a majority of people living around campus are undergrad students (18 - 22 years old)

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Turning in a research proposal as part of one class that I had been working on throughout the semester and getting overwhelmingly positive feedback.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Staying on top of the workload and not get demotivated.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
